reconstructions, obtained from a first paleomagnetic pole,
age-constrained by a fold test, from In Ezzane area
in the Murzuq basin (Algeria, stable Africa)

7.Conclusion
450Ma 480Ma Pangeareconstructionisstillsubjectofdebates(forreview,see
Domeier et al., 2012; Stampfli et al., 2013). For the Moscovian
times,ournewGondwanapole,combinedwiththeLaurussiaone
500Ma (k=32.5(cid:2)S,/=46.6(cid:2)E,A =6.3(cid:2))translatedinNorthWestAfrican
95
coordinatesfromDomeieretal.(2012)yieldsamoreconstrained
370Ma 350Ma reconstruction (Fig. 13). Though the previous reconstruction was
430Ma based only on the West Gondwana (Domeier et al., 2012), the
330Ma uncertaintyonthelocationoftheGondwanapolebecomesmore
reduced, A decreasing from 3.3(cid:2) (4.3(cid:2) for the inclination-cor-
310Ma 95
recteddata assumed as morerealisticin thecited paper)to 1.8(cid:2).
300Ma Improvementofthisreconstructionneedsnownewpaleomagnetic
400Ma
250Ma 280Ma works or dating improvement in Laurussia. There are in fact few
well-dated formations of this age in Laurussia because most of
deposits correspond to continental facies. However, better-speci-
fied paleontological or radiometric age determinations as well as
new paleomagnetic studies in the few well-dated marine forma-
tionsinthissuper-continentarethekeytohaveareliablerecon-
structionforthiskeyperiodoftheHercyniantimes.
